ai.summary: Corrects parsing logic in `getPreviouslyReadFiles` to handle `file_updates` tool outputs by accessing the nested `files` array, resolving prior type errors. Introduces `additionalToolResultSchemas` and `fileUpdatesResultSchema` in `common/src/tools/params/tool/file-updates.ts` to define strict Zod types for result-only tools. Updates `CodebuffToolOutput`, `CodebuffToolResult`, and `CodebuffToolMessage` types in `common/src/tools/list.ts` to support the new schema structure. Ensures `backend/src/run-agent-step.ts` and `backend/src/util/messages.ts` correctly interpret `file_updates` outputs without runtime crashes.

eli5.text: When the assistant looks back at a list of files it already read while working on your project, the tool now correctly pulls the file details out of the right spot in the response, so it no longer crashes or misreads the information. Previously, the code tried to read file results as if they were all stored in the same format, but the file-updates tool wraps its results in a different shape, causing errors; now the parsing logic understands that difference and handles each tool's output correctly. This affects any task where the assistant reviews previously read files, making that step reliable instead of failing silently or producing wrong results. The fix is live today for all agents using the updated tooling.

Behind the scenes, the server now sends both overall totals and per-version totals, and the metrics panel picks the matching version when you have one selected, falling back to zero if no data exists yet.

ai.title: Remove 50-agent fetch limit on publisher page
ai.summary: The publisher page now fetches all agents for a publisher instead of limiting the query to 50 results. The `.limit(50)` call was removed from the database query in `web/src/app/publishers/[id]/page.tsx`. This change allows the page to display the complete list of agents for grouping, regardless of quantity.

eli5.text: If you look at a publisher's page, it now shows every agent they offer instead of stopping at 50. Previously, the page cut off the list once it hit 50 agents, which meant some agents never appeared. The fix simply removed that 50-item cap from the data lookup, so the complete list loads no matter how many agents a publisher has. This works today for anyone viewing a publisher page.
